name: Van Halen I Brown
reference: Ain't Talkin' 'bout Love / Runnin' with the Devil: Van Halen (1978, Sunset Sound, prod. Ted Templeman, eng. Donn Landee)
rig: Frankenstrat (single rewound PAF bridge humbucker) -> unmodified late-60s Marshall 1959 Super Lead 100 W, everything on 10, mains turned down with a Variac -> Marshall 4x12; Sunset Sound plate/chamber on the other side of the mix
notes: Amp = Slammin 1959HW captured through a real Variac at 180 V with EQ and Volume I dimed (the author's recommended start). Cab = plain Greenback 1960TV SM57 (the song-voiced VH IRs are of unknown method). Ambience = Sunset Sound plate IR made to approximate the VH plate, 25% wet. SW8 LEAD = TS9 clean push (not on the record) + a generic 340 ms solo echo (the record has no tempo-synced delay). Unconfirmed [verify]: the Variac voltage (interviews quote 89 V to 'around 90'), Greenback vs JBL speakers, and the opposite-side plate panning. No Phase 90 or electric sitar in TONE3000; Spread is off. Levels are unmeasured. Research: 80s-tones.md shortlist (captures and model ids checked with `tone3000.py models`).

left.label: Ibanez TS9 clean push, D0 T6 L10 (lead boost, not on the record)
